preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 50.
The length of each edge is between 1 and 50.
The starting vertex for the policeman is between 1 and n.
The number of criminals is between 1 and 50.
Each criminal's location is a unique vertex different from the policeman's starting point.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'Terrorists win' if the policeman can't catch all criminals, or an integer representing the time needed to catch all criminals.
